_doc: The VT350's credits list (vt350#220): the upstream projects whose work this repo redistributes (REUSE.toml) or its public pages show (cad/viewer/licences.json, each rule's 'credit' names a project 'key' here, or 'own'). platform/pages/credits.py builds CREDITS.md from the three; --check fails when CREDITS.md is stale, when a REUSE holder or a rule's credit has no project here, or when a project here is used by neither. 'reuse': the REUSE.toml SPDX-FileCopyrightText holders that are this project. 'licence_urls': where a licence with no text in LICENSES/ is read (an SPDX id without one links to spdx.org).
title: Credits
intro: The VT350 is built on other people's work. This page lists every upstream project the repository redistributes (the files [`REUSE.toml`](REUSE.toml) labels) and every one whose parts the [public reference pages](https://dvystrcil.github.io/vt350/) show (the parts [`cad/viewer/licences.json`](cad/viewer/licences.json) clears). Each keeps its own licence; the licence texts are in [`LICENSES/`](LICENSES/).

Everything not credited here is this project's own work, under [GPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSES/GPL-3.0-or-later.txt). The repository and its pages are non-commercial: nothing here is sold, and the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and GrabCAD parts are shown on that basis only.
